nodes.odebrane.text.t: The letter vanishes into the dark of the hollow, and somewhere down by the roots something cracks softly. A moment later a purse turns up under the moss, with a handful of groats in it. Someone was waiting for this delivery.

nodes.s.text.t: The oak stands alone, with a hollow at chest height. Inside it's empty and dry, as if someone has hidden things here before.
